t: A nature mapping game where players log wildlife sightings from their phones.
steps: Find QuestaGame or the Spirits of the Realms app in a phone app store.
Read the privacy policy at the privacy-policy page of the site.
Ask the vendor about the schools program and its cost.
Decide which student details to share. Accounts take a name and email.
Join the BioQuest competition through the P-12 page.
Turn off location sharing unless it is needed.
